wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.role: the caution shown on every approval card raised in a conversation that has received a message from another person's agent
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.tone: calm, plain, operator-facing; two short sentences, no dashes
wire.bridge_taint.card_notice.note: SAFETY COPY: this sentence is part of a security control (it is how the user learns why approvals tightened). Translate it so it stays exactly as true as the English; never soften, shorten or reassure beyond it. Agent messages is the product name of Team Bridge: render it exactly as this locale renders wire.settings.team_bridge.title (MATCH that string, translated as it is there; do not leave it in English unless that title is), capitalised as there. "A teammate's agent" is another person's agent, never the user's own agent team or subagents. A latched conversation is one that has received such a message: a real inbound message or room page, never merely a directory listing, a send receipt or an error notice. Rendered on the TUI card, the desktop and phone (as the first line of the pending description) and the y/N terminal prompt.

wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off.role: one line on a latched TUI approval card saying why Allow all and the set-auto shortcuts are missing and how to get auto back
wire.bridge_taint.card_options_off.note: SAFETY COPY: this sentence is part of a security control (it is how the user learns why approvals tightened). Translate it so it stays exactly as true as the English; never soften, shorten or reassure beyond it. Keep `/approvals auto` and `/new` verbatim: they are commands. "in the terminal" is deliberate: the desktop and phone cannot turn auto back on in such a conversation yet. Also flashed, as one line, when the user presses A, S or G on such a card.

wire.bridge_taint.full_request.role: label in front of the untruncated arguments of a tool call on a latched approval card
wire.bridge_taint.full_request.note: {request} is the call's raw JSON arguments; never translate or reorder it.

wire.bridge_taint.card_notice_other_sess.role: the caution shown on every approval card raised in a conversation that received content from another of the user's sessions or devices (the twin of wire.bridge_taint.card_notice, used when no Agent message reached this conversation directly)

wire.bridge_taint.card_notice_other_sess.note: SAFETY COPY: this sentence is part of a security control (it is how the user learns why approvals tightened). Translate it so it stays exactly as true as the English; never soften, shorten or reassure beyond it. "Another session or device" means the user's OWN other conversations or their own other machines (a sessions peek, a mesh reply, a parent or child session, a copied transcript), never another person; do not render it as a team or a colleague. "May contain" is deliberate: that other session might itself have received a message from a teammate's agent, or its state cannot be checked, so the sentence must not claim it did or that it did not. "A teammate's agent" is another person's agent, never the user's own agents or subagents; do not use a bare word for 'team' for the user's own agents. Rendered on the TUI card, the desktop and phone (as the first line of the pending description).
